steps.text: 9:30 P.M. Training Grounds

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Thanks for being Bubble's practice partner today.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's hard to find someone who can keep the upper hand against her and still have strength to spare.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: And sorry about keeping you so late.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Instructor Dobermann is strict in training, but very nice otherwise.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She's always up until so late at night.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: It's fine, I didn't have anything else anyway.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (It's unbelievable how good Bubble is, given her age.)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I wish more people would learn from you.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Are you hungry? It's getting late, so why don't you get something from the cafeteria, and put it on my tab.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Thank you.
9:34 P.M. Cafeteria

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Heat... How do I heat up food?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is this the machine?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It makes a noise, but no heat.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is it this one?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: There's a little picture of a fire on it. Does it want you to heat the machine with fire?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Put the food in the machine, then light a fire outside... like this, right?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Why did it explode?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: That's not how you use it.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Good thing you didn't get hurt...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Wait, someone I don't know?!)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (W-What was I thinking? I just reflexively...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (And she's an Archosauria too. A new Archosauria colleague?)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Excuse me, how do I heat up my food...?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Use this one.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I mean... wait 5 minutes, then press this button.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Don't touch the broken one.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Just put in a maintenance ticket, and someone else will fix it.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Gah, I acted weird again, didn't I?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (The Doctor and Lena wanted me to interact more with others...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I've always used the excuse that it's hard to talk to people who've been here longer than me.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (But this time, she seems new here.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (What do I do now...?)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Done already, Estelle?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I guess I forgot about dinner.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Yes... I've eaten.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She might still be in the cafeteria. I'll go later...)
9:22 A.M. Convalescent Garden

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Feeling relaxed?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Lena, code name 'Perfumer.')

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I come here at the same time every day for aromatherapy.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (It's how I start my day.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She smells good, and she's so nice. I wish I had a big sister like her.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: This scent works best on you.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: It... reminds me of home.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But it's not the scent of a flower... it's a vitamin solution.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If you want to talk about your past, I'm here to listen, as is the Doctor.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: No pressure, though.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I know why this scent makes me relaxed... it smells just like the lab I was in when I was little.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (That was before I grew horns.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I lived in a small house. There were many small houses like it in the oval room, each with an Archosauria child living in it.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (They called me a 'failure' and threw me out of the lab.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (The guy who did it was named Danny Chip. He even used to say 'Good morning, my princess' to me through the glass every morning...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Was I abandoned because I'm so unlikeable?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (After that, I lived in the barrens until I joined Rhodes Island.)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I don't know what you're thinking about, but this is a time to relax.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Have you had a proper conversation with anyone lately?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I... don't think so...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I don't want to force you, but you could try talking to people you feel comfortable with.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: All I can do is to help you temporarily relax. You're the only one who can take that step.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I understand. Thank you Lena.
2:15 P.M. Medical Department Corridor

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: I heard we have some new colleagues.

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: Seems like there are new faces every day. Rhodes Island is getting livelier.

steps.name: Earthspirit
steps.text: And the queue at the cafeteria is getting longer too.

steps.name: Earthspirit
steps.text: Taking care of the new employees was easier when there were fewer people around. I can hardly even remember their names these days.

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: But isn't it your job as a senior member to look after them? Remember how Eyjafjalla used to follow you around like a baby fowlbeast chasing its mother? I think you have a knack for taking care of people.

steps.name: Fowlbeast
steps.text: (Joyful cry)

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: Whoa! I didn't mean it literally!

steps.name: Earthspirit
steps.text: Calm down, it's just Estelle's Sir Cromwell.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Earthspirit has horns on her head too, but I guess that's normal for a Caprinae.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Hers are smaller than mine, but much longer.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Would they hit the ceiling if something surprised her in the Doctor's office?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (If I was closer to her, maybe I could talk to her about how to deal with all the problems with having horns.)

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: Is this your pet, Estelle?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Breeze always looks so elegant... I wish I could ask her how to be like that too...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (But Sir Cromwell's not my pet. He's my friend.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (He's the one who found my house and opened the door after I was thrown out of the lab.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (He knows so much more than I do, but he doesn't talk much, and he likes to swear.)

steps.name: Breeze
steps.text: There are a number of support missions scheduled for next week. We'll be counting on you, Estelle.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Breeze is a skilled battlefield medic, so we're often paired together on assignments. Maybe she can sense my discomfort, because she's always so nice and careful around me.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I really appreciate it, but she also feels a little distant... and we hardly ever see each other outside of work.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (The Doctor wants me to take the initiative to talk to her...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I... I'll work hard to bring the patients back...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I couldn't say it. Again.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Sir Cromwell! Don't go! Come back!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: You'll cause trouble for others... and make my coworkers dislike me.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Come to think of it, they were just talking about taking care of new recruits...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: What about that Archosauria I saw yesterday? Does she have anyone to help her?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: She'll get hurt if she's reckless around machines again, like last time.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: But... what can I do? When I'm like... this?

steps.name: Sir Cromwell
steps.text: (Meaningful crow)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Stop laughing, Sir Cromwell.

steps.name: Sir Cromwell
steps.text: (Soft humming)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm getting treatment and going to the Convalescent Garden every day. But I'm still nervous about meeting others of my kind.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I can see at a glance how different I am from them... so won't they too? Will they think my horns are disgusting?

steps.name: Sir Cromwell
steps.text: (Short chirping)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Gavial?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Gavial is an Archosauria too. I see her often at work, but I could never muster the courage to speak to her... I don't know what she thinks of me.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: *Sigh* We're both Archosauria, but she's a great doctor, while I can't seem to do anything right.

steps.name: Injured Operator
steps.text: Wait! Gavial, I'm not ready yet!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wait for what? It'll be over in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Injured Operator
steps.text: The blink of an... arrrggghhh!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Is she on duty today?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I always hear cries like this when she is.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I wonder what's happening inside...

steps.name: Sir Cromwell
steps.text: (Curious crow)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Wait, where are you going—

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (It's the girl who almost blew herself up yesterday!)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? You're...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She saw me!)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: S-She's strong...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Are you okay? I'm sorry... I...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, I'm fine!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You're so strong!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Er... yeah...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's okay!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I have to thank you for yesterday. I wouldn't have known how to heat up my food if you hadn't been there.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I just happened to pass by and saw...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I, er, I'm a little busy right now, so—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Man, my hands are getting sore. Watch over the wounded while I go loosen up my arms a little.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Mm, fresh air!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Did I just see someone skitter by?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Maybe I'm just tired?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Whew, she almost found us. Good thing there was an empty room here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I saved you this time, so we're even!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It'd be bad if Gavial found out.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: W-What do you mean?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You came to spy on Gavial at work, didn't you?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (This newcomer seems to have misunderstood... I need to explain, or I'll leave a bad impression on her...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm not—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I came to spy on her too!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Do you know her well?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Er... I guess so...?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I often work with her, but we've barely spoken to each other.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You like her, don't you?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She's a doctor of Rhodes Island. She lives in a different world from someone like me, who's doing odd jobs while receiving treatment.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (When I think of it like that, it's easy enough to convince myself that hiding from her like this is normal.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Well, yes, I think she's amazing.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Then we're friends.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Friends... you want to be friends with me?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We already know each other, and we both agree Gavial's amazing!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I... guess so...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Then we're friends.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I made friends with a new recruit...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I should report to the Doctor and Lena.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I didn't do anything in particular, but I'm sure they'll be proud of me.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: My name's Tomimi. What about you?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm... Estelle.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Calm down. Keep it friendly by making small talk.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (You can do it.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is it a code name?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: No, it's my real name.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It doesn't sound Archosauria.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It sounds familiar though.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is it the Ash Princess?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: You know her?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I heard the story from Inam.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Estelle the Ash Princess was chased out from her castle when bad people took over. But she never gave up, and kept working on her swordsmanship.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: When the time came, she snuck into a party at the castle in a dress, with the help of the loyal Sir Cromwell.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: And at the climax, she put on her armor, caught the sword thrown to her by Sir Cromwell, and completed her revenge.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Some say that she turned to ash once her goal was complete.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Oh no, I started talking and just kept going...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Is it going to put her off? I really should learn to keep my mouth shut...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You really know the story!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I can tell how much you admire her.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Yes... I want to be like her.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (She... doesn't seem so scary.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I wish I could wear a helmet like the princess though.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (They say Rhodes Island has good blacksmiths, but I don't know any of them. Since I don't use weapons in battle, I've never gone to talk to one.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I should muster the courage to go ask them to make me a suit of armor, like the one the princess wore.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You should practice the sword then.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (And learn how to fight using weapons.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Learning from someone who uses a greatsword... Skadi, maybe...? But it's hard to talk to her...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But why did you run away when you saw me?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Er, it's nothing...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm, well, not very confident about my appearance...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Appearance?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Turn around and let me take a look.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: By our standards, it's neither thick or thin... It doesn't really stand out.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Doesn't that mean that it's normal?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I look normal to you?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: But back home, people laughed at me and called me a weirdo because of it...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They don't understand. Sometimes, it's prettier this way.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Like, take Gavial—

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Did Gavial have horns too?)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: People like her not just because of how she looks, but because of how strong she is, the way she's invincible in battle.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Oh—ah!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: So you mean I should become strong?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Not quite.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I've thought about it a lot, and I think the reason people like Gavial is because she's Gavial.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Be yourself. The people who like you will like you. You don't have to make yourself uncomfortable just to get people to like you.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (That's how another Archosauria sees my horns?)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I once read a book called 'One Step from Confidence.' It said that people's tastes change all the time; the important thing is what you think about yourself.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Come find me if you want to borrow it.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: It's really a pain sometimes though. I might accidentally poke the door when I'm going to the Doctor's office, and it's harder to swing a sword like the Ash Princess.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hm... I guess so.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But not only does it help you balance, it can also be used as a weapon. That more than makes up for making it a little harder to swing a sword.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So if you think about it, a tail is very useful.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I see!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (So she was talking about my tail...? I guess she misunderstood what I meant... I like my tail...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (My horns are heavy, but the tail helps me keep my balance.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (It's a good tail.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (But she seems totally unconcerned about my horns... I guess not everyone cares about them... I didn't expect it to be so easy to talk to another Archosauria...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I like you too.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes. That's why we're friends.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Not as good as Gavial, but like, 0.7 Gavials.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: T-Thank you!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Does she use Gavial as a unit of measurement?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (0.7 Gavials must be high praise.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: So... how many Gavials is the Doctor?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Never thought about it...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Maybe we can score everyone on Rhodes Island later.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Measured in Gavials?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Let's do it!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, looks like Gavial went back.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Let's go spy on her again.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Sorry... I have to get back to work.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Rhodes Island might throw me out if I don't work hard enough...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What do you do here, Estelle? Are you in the combat squad too?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Where'd that come from?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Is this how friends talk?)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I am, but I usually work more on the support and rescue side.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Like carrying stuff, moving patients, or evacuating the wounded.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Sometimes I'm also involved in direct combat, like when rescuing the wounded in the heat of battle.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Or escorting our doctors.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Incredible...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: It's nothing, really...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Just imagine being hurt on the battlefield, surrounded by enemies and at your wit's end, then seeing Estelle dash to the rescue.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You'd shine so brightly in their eyes. You might even go as high as 0.9 Gavials!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (So even a job like this earns people's respect.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Even better if you deliver them straight to Gavial for treatment.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: 0.9 Gavials plus 1 Gavial is... 8 Gavials...?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes, they'll recover even quicker, for sure.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Right. I'll try to send them to Gavial next time then.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: But, er, I really do have to go... it's getting late.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It was nice chatting with you.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Me too.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I wish I could keep things at 0.9 Gavials.)
7:23 P.M. Engineering Department

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I never knew making a friend would make me so happy.)

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Oh? You're still working, Estelle?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Breeze said there might be dispatch missions next week, so I wanted to load some supplies first.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: There's no overtime pay for this, you know.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: That's fine.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I often ride in Greypaw's car when I'm on a mission with Breeze.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (The roof's been modified to give more room for supplies, and more importantly, my horns.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I'm less nervous when I'm talking to someone I know.)

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Kids like you should learn to rest when you can.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Otherwise, you'll pay the price when you get older.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Just look at all the neck and back pain I get.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: A few more long-distance trips, and I'd just about break into a thousand pieces.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Does it hurt that much?

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I think I know how to help.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I wonder if Gavial's still on duty.)

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Really? Hope it works.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Wait—
8:20 P.M. Medical Department Corridor

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You're back, Estelle.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I just brought a colleague who's not feeling well.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Looks like Gavial's gonna be there for a while longer.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm waiting to eat with her.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: I'm waiting for Greypaw's treatment to finish.

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Wait, it's just a bit of neck pain!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, since you're here, how about a little massage?

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: No! I'm fine! It doesn't hurt at all!

steps.name: Greypaw
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhh––!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Sounds like it's working well.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Is it?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Forceful treatment always works well.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What are you smiling about?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: Oh, it's nothing.

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I'm glad to have made a friend, and to have helped a colleague.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Even though I still couldn't say it.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (At Rhodes Island, no one laughs at my horns, or scolds me for being clumsy.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (There's still a lot I don't know, but I'm learning every day.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, looks like they're done.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I made a new friend, Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Where did she go?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're not seeing things, are you?

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Whew...)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (I ran away again.)

steps.name: Estelle
steps.text: (Looks like I still have a long way to go.)
The Archosauria girl sighs, lifts her head, and presses herself against the walls of the clinic, horns and all.
There is no smell of vitamin solution, but she feels surprisingly relaxed.
The dark night and scattered stars outside the windows are no different from what she'd seen out on the barrens for so many years.
Today, however, she is home. Here at Rhodes Island.
